<thought>To locate the correct retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the target molecule SMILES and specifying the functional groups that are formed in the forward Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons reaction (an aliphatic carboxylic acid and a C‑C double bond). I will omit the broken‑group filter because the allowed functional‑group list does not include C‑P or C‑O as separate entries. This should return the template(s) that match the described transformation, from which I can extract the template ID and then retrieve the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
